name: mode-atlas
description: Mode Atlas static web app smoke tests

scripts.release:check: python3 build_revision_assets.py && python3 sync_ios_project.py && python3 validate_ios_firebase_config.py --require && python3 audit_project.py && python3 build_ios_web.py --check && node --test tests/backend.test.js tests/frontend.test.js tests/ios-foundation.test.js tests/ios-theme.test.js tests/study-flow.test.js tests/progression.test.js
scripts.ios:sync: python3 sync_ios_project.py && npm run build:ios-web && npx cap sync ios && python3 sync_ios_project.py --normalize-spm-links
scripts.test:polish: playwright test tests/polish.spec.js tests/ios-theme.spec.js tests/ios-home.spec.js tests/ios-experience.spec.js tests/study-flow.spec.js tests/trainer-modes.spec.js tests/progression.spec.js
